name: Brown University
character: Situated on College Hill and integrated into Providence's urban fabric, the campus features Georgian and Richardsonian Romanesque buildings, brick and wrought-iron fences, and landscaped greens.

landmarks.name: Van Wickle Gates
landmarks.quote: the Van Wickle Gates are a set of wrought iron gates that stand at the western edge of Brown's campus.
landmarks.look: Wrought iron gates with a larger central gate and two smaller side gates.

landmarks.name: Main or College Green
landmarks.quote: defined by three greens: the Front or Quiet Green, the Main or College Green, and the Ruth J. Simmons Quadrangle
landmarks.look: A grassy open campus green surrounded by historic brick buildings.

landmarks.name: Ruth J. Simmons Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: and the Ruth J. Simmons Quadrangle (historically known as Lincoln Field).
landmarks.look: A grassy campus quadrangle bordered by academic buildings.

landmarks.name: John Hay Library
landmarks.quote: Facing the western edge of the central campus sit two of the Brown's seven libraries, the John Hay Library
landmarks.look: A historic library building facing the western edge of the central campus.

landmarks.name: John Carter Brown Library
landmarks.quote: the John Carter Brown Library... has been owned by Brown and located on its campus since 1904.
landmarks.look: A classic early 20th-century library building on the main campus.

landmarks.name: Haffenreffer Museum of Anthropology
landmarks.quote: The exhibition galleries of the Haffenreffer Museum of Anthropology, Brown's teaching museum, are located in Manning Hall on the campus's main green.
landmarks.look: A historic hall housing museum galleries on the main green.

landmarks.name: The Walk
landmarks.quote: The Walk, a landscaped pedestrian corridor, connects the Pembroke Campus to the main campus.
landmarks.look: A landscaped pedestrian walkway with public art sculptures.

landmarks.name: College Hill
landmarks.quote: Brown's main campus, comprises 235 buildings and 143 acres (58 ha) in the East Side neighborhood of College Hill.
landmarks.look: A sloped urban hill covered with historic brick campus buildings.
